author: Zephyr IV
title: Debug: Sentinel Write Return Value
abstract: Calls sentinel_write and prints the type and content of the result for debugging.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.anomaly_experiments.sentinel import sentinel_write

sentinel_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/plasticity/debug_sentinel.txt'
content = 'DEBUG'
result = sentinel_write(sentinel_path, len(content), content)
print(f"Type of result: {type(result)}")
print(f"Content of result: {result}")
